title: Pallet Town
subtitle: Choose a starter, first rival battle, Oak's Parcel

steps.text: Set your starter and add it in Team so the guide shows the right rival teams and battle advice.
Leave your house (check the PC upstairs for a free Potion) and try to walk north into the tall grass. Professor Oak stops you and takes you to his lab.
Pick your starter. Bulbasaur makes Brock and Misty easy; Charmander struggles early but gets Metal Claw at Lv.13; Squirtle is the balanced pick. The rival takes the one that beats yours.

encounter.savePoint: Save in front of the Poké Balls in Oak's Lab before choosing
encounter.note: Shiny is decided when you receive it; soft reset until it sparkles.

steps.text: Rival battle 1 in the lab. Spam your attack move; Growl/Tail Whip is a waste.
Walk north through Route 1. The Mart clerk on the path gives you a free Potion. Pidgey and Rattata here are fine early catches once you have Poké Balls.
In Viridian City, the Poké Mart clerk hands you Oak's Parcel. Take it back to Professor Oak in Pallet Town.
Deliver the parcel: Oak gives you and your rival the Pokédex. Rival's sister Daisy (rival's house) gives you the Town Map.
Back in Viridian City, buy Poké Balls (at least 5) and a couple of Potions. Antidotes help in Viridian Forest.
Old man in Viridian City demonstrates catching, then the Pokémon Center-side house: the man on the north exit gives the Teachy TV.
Viridian Gym is locked until you have 7 badges. Route 22 (west) has the first optional rival battle once you have a Pokémon around Lv.8+ — see chapter 2.
